document.abstract: The Sound Committee purposes to encourage any advancement that will bring about improvements in the recording and reproducing of sound. To facilitate an orderly procedure and also to present to the Society a comprehensive picture of the problems involved, an outline has been prepared which shows the major elements on which faithful reproduction of sound depends. Opposite each item in the outline are given references to pertinent discussions in technical literature. While this bibliography is not complete, the Committee feels that it is sufficiently inclusive to permit ready reference to fairly wide and varied sources of useful information. It appears as an appendix to this report. The Sound Committee has confined its specific considerations to four timely and important subjects appearing in the outline and presents to the Society the results of its studies.
